Hero_Desc_Asana:
A witch who left the palace and returned to graduate school to hone her martial arts.
Dreaming of improving the health of every witch, she pours her passion into research each day.
She developed her own form of exercise called 'Ball Yoga' and hopes to spread it to everyone.
Album_Like_Asana: The peace of researching without interruption, having her work recognized
Album_Hate_Asana: Anything harmful to one's health, people who ridicule her
Album_Hobby_Asana: Designing new and efficient yoga poses
Album_Wish_Asana: To spread her Ball Yoga throughout Elias
Album_Asana1: Asana is a witch who relinquished her position as a high-ranking witch and voluntarily became a graduate student so she could hone her martial arts and research the health of witches.
Album_Asana2: Asana likes having her abilities recognized. Whenever she looks upset, a few well-placed compliments will send her spirits soaring as though nothing had happened.
Album_Asana3: Though she often comes across as rather scatterbrained, no one takes health more seriously than Asana. Whenever I see her passionately expounding on better health, I cannot help but cheer her on.
Album_Asana4: Hilde is Asana's most important research partner. Asana is always eager to ask Hilde for feedback, but for some reason, Hilde appears to find her enthusiasm a little overwhelming.
Album_Asana5: Surprisingly, Asana does not particularly relate to Rudd's love of exercise. According to her, Rudd's workouts are driven by something beyond the simple pursuit of health.
Album_Asana6: After the incident involving Belita, Asana joined the Order and now visits once a week to teach me yoga. Yoga with her is literally pure agony, but the witches around her say there are few times when Asana looks happier than while preparing for a yoga session.
Album_Asana7: After yoga class, I was so exhausted that I took a bite of a muffin to replenish my sugar, only for Asana to catch me. That day, a red-faced Asana treated me to the full Yoga Hell course.
LoveHero_Asana: Wonderful! From now on, you will practice one-on-one yoga with me every day, Master~!
LoveHeroCancel_Asana: You are not quitting because it is too difficult... are you?
Food_ChefNote_Asana_Hate1: Asana stared silently down at the macaron with a terrifying glare, then abruptly grabbed my hand and pulled me away. Without knowing why, I was subjected to the full Yoga Hell course.
Food_ChefNote_Asana_Hate2: The moment the food was served, Asana slammed the table and stood up. She summoned me to the backyard and spent an hour lecturing me about avoiding sweets.
Food_ChefNote_Asana_Like1: Asana seems completely captivated by the clean, mild flavor of the coconut and pine-needle porridge. She said it would be perfect after training, so I made plenty of extra for her to take.
Food_ChefNote_Asana_Like2: Asana excitedly declared that everyone in Elias should love the one-bite leaf wrap. She seems to have started devising a way to make everyone eat it.
Food_ChefNote_Asana_Like3: Asana likes it as a healthy, satisfying meal. She emptied a bowl in one sitting and copied the recipe into her notebook.
Food_ChefNote_Asana_Like4: She marveled that food could be made from wood and praised it as remarkable research. Watching her eat and analyze it so earnestly, I could not bring myself to tell her the truth.
Food_ChefNote_Asana_Like5: She rated it highly for being convenient to carry and eat, saying it would be perfect for a light meal during yoga.
Food_ChefNote_Asana_Like6: She was delighted by how easy it was to eat and how quickly it made her feel full. Somehow, she accurately picked out only the songpyeon filled with beans.
Food_ChefNote_Asana_Like7: Though it was a little sweet for her taste, she said the beautiful gift box seemed to convey the giver's feelings, which made her happy.
Food_ChefNote_Asana_Like8: Asana was fascinated, saying she had never seen food that could provide only the specific nutrients one needed.
Food_ChefNote_Asana_Like9: After rolling it around in her mouth for several minutes, Asana declared that she should research lollipop-style health food and began scribbling furiously in her notebook.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Asana: Keep your back straight! Stretch those legs!
Gacha_Result_Line1_Asana: With me, everyone can become healthy!
Gacha_Result_Line2_Asana: A graduate student who keeps stretching
Asana_Spawn1: Hehe, it is my turn to step forward!
Asana_Spawn2: Do not worry. I am here!
Asana_Growth1: Stretching my legs is bound to stretch my abilities too!
Asana_Victory1: Can you still refuse to acknowledge Asana's yoga after this?!
Asana_Victory2: Hehe, did you see? That is the importance of physical training!
Asana_Defeat2: W-wait a moment. Something is wrong here!
Asana_Affinity1_1: There can be no compromise where the health of body and mind is concerned.
Asana_Affinity1_2: Devoting yourself to work is admirable, but you must not neglect your health either.
Asana_Affinity2: If yoga feels difficult, picture a tree. Root your strength below, then stretch out as its branches do!
Asana_Affinity1_3: A healthy mind comes from a healthy body.
Asana_Affinity3: Do I miss my days as a high witch? Pfft! Not at all.
Asana_Affinity4: Ah, that posture! You are far too hunched over! Hold still a moment. I shall correct it for you.
Asana_Affinity5: Phew, you really ought to read my ultimate thesis sometime, Master... What, you will read it now? L-Later!
Asana_Affinity6: Did you know there is yoga for two people as well? Here, take my hand!
Asana_Affinity7: You will... keep doing yoga, right? You will, will you not? You understand?
Asana_Die2: I-it is ruined! I never thought this would happen!!
Asana_LevelUp: Ah~ Is it truly all right for me to become stronger than I am now?
Asana_Equipment: Training martial arts does not mean I would refuse excellent equipment!
Asana_HeroSkill: Skilled technique matters more than brute force.
Asana_HeroUpgrade: Ah! This is the moment my ball yoga evolves to an entirely new level!
Asana_Board: Ah! Do we go that way?
Asana_DeckSetting1: Before we begin, shall everyone warm up together?
Asana_DeckSetting2: Hehe, you may look forward to this.
Asana_Stage: It is time to demonstrate the effects of my ball yoga!
Asana_Touch1_1: Ugh! Do not pinch; massage gently!!
Asana_Touch1_2: Whew, fine. Let us count this as yoga too.
Asana_Touch2: Hmm? Is this a scalp massage? Thank you!
Asana_Touch2_2: It need not benefit my health... Would you continue?
Asana_DutchRubEnd2: Even a trained body hurts when struck like this!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Asana_Skin1: Asana volunteered to help Hilde with her patients and prepared her own interpretation of a nurse's uniform... She does understand what a nurse is, right?
Asana_Growth1_Skin1: I shall do my utmost to make the patient comfortable.
Asana_Growth2_Skin1: Do nurses not teach anything like yoga? I am a little bored.
Asana_LevelUp_Skin1: Given my field of research, there is no possibility I could fail at this~!
Asana_Equipment_Skin1: Thorough equipment maintenance is a nurse's basic discipline.
Asana_HeroSkill_Skin1: I can give injections gently, without hurting~
Asana_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: Sigh, Asana. Is there anything you cannot do?
Asana_Touch1_Skin1: Do you perhaps do this because you do not want an injection?
Asana_Touch1_1_Skin1: Will you continue interfering with treatment like this?
Asana_Touch1_2_Skin1: Sigh, shall we abandon everything and move straight to yoga?
Asana_Touch2_Skin1: Oh my? Hehe, it seems you enjoyed my nursing.
Asana_Touch2_1_Skin1: Hehe, what a good child~ Our Master!
Asana_Touch2_2_Skin1: If you keep this up... you may have to nurse me, Master.
Asana_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Continue and I shall have no choice but to give you a painful injection!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Asana_Skin2: Team Leader Asana keeps asking everyone to stand up and stretch in the middle of work. Stretching in the center of the office makes it difficult not to feel self-conscious.
Asana_Growth1_Skin2: Your body might stiffen if you do nothing but sit around.
Asana_Growth2_Skin2: Shall we pause our work and stretch for a moment?
Asana_LevelUp_Skin2: Moving my body makes my mood go up! Up!
Asana_Equipment_Skin2: Equipment doubles the efficiency of stretching!
Asana_HeroSkill_Skin2: I thought of a new stretching method!
Asana_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: Now I can approach my work in an even finer pose!
Asana_Board_Skin2: Now, shall we unfold everyone's dreams here?!
Asana_Touch1_Skin2: What is wrong with stretching in the office?!
Asana_Touch2_Skin2: The carrot and the stick should coexist.
Asana_Touch2_1_Skin2: Praise like this is not bad either.
Asana_Touch2_2_Skin2: Would you follow me to my office for a moment?
Asana_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: How rude! Your overtime is confirmed!
Asana_AsideGet: Surpass the limits! Forge an even finer body!
Asana_AsideUpgrade: No pose is impossible with this magnificent body!
Asana_Birthday: Happy birthday, Master. Today I shall specially teach you the three-tier cake pose.
Asana_Gacha2: With me, everyone can become healthy.
Asana_Gacha3: Keep your back straight and stretch your legs fully.
Asana_Line1: A healthy mind dwells within a healthy body.
Asana_Line2: Do not worry needlessly. Begin by copying my pose.
Asana_Line3: I will do anything if it helps spread ball yoga.
Asana_Lobby: Would everyone like to learn yoga?
LoveLetter_Asana:
Hello, Master! This is Asana, Elias's foremost pioneer of Ball Yoga. As always, I am training my mind and body and enjoying peaceful days. Have your days been peaceful as well, Master? 

You must take care of your health while you are still healthy. Even when it feels troublesome, please eat proper meals, exercise every day, and stay well! If your mind and body ever become weary, please contact me. I have prepared 101 ways to soothe them!
LoveCall_Asana:
Master~! Can you hear me? I have thrilling news for you!
Do not be surprised... I, Asana, have once again developed another new yoga pose just for you, Master! It is already the twenty-third!
If you use this pose instead of the one I recommended before, it will double the efficiency of meditative breathing and full-body muscle relaxation! You are happy too, are you not, Master?!

Since it will be your first time trying the pose, I am sure it will still feel awkward...
So, in your room, Master, you and I will practice together all night until you can hold it comfortably!
The last time I visited, I was thrown out because of your screams... But do not worry! I have plenty of ways to slip past the High Priestess and reach your room! Hehe!
Affinity_Asana_EP01_001: Would you like to meditate with me?
Affinity_Asana_EP01_003: Hehe, wonderful. I even brought my yoga mat. We only need to move that table over there. Where should we put it?
Affinity_Asana_EP01_005: Why not?! Master, your dark circles have been terrible lately, your shoulders look stiff, and your neck is hunched forward. You clearly need yoga! Come here!
Affinity_Asana_EP01_006: Have things been difficult for you lately?
Affinity_Asana_EP01_007: Ugh... Yes... I am the one who needs meditation. Please join me, my meditation partner...
Affinity_Asana_EP02_001: Hauu... I have been sitting constantly while writing my paper, and now my whole body feels stiff.
Affinity_Asana_EP02_002: What happened to all that yoga?
Affinity_Asana_EP02_003: What a hurtful thing to say! I only feel this well because I practice yoga whenever I find a spare moment!
Affinity_Asana_EP02_004: Yoga really is best at times like this.
Affinity_Asana_EP02_005: Exactly. But I do not even have enough time for yoga! Ahhh~! I want to do yoga!!!
Affinity_Asana_EP02_006: At times like this, you need a good night's sleep.
Affinity_Asana_EP02_007: I-Is that so? I suppose I have not slept much. Perhaps... seventy-two hours...?
Affinity_Asana_EP03_002: It sounds as though someone is about to be sent to a farm upstate...
Affinity_Asana_EP03_003: Inhale... Exhale... Inhaaaale... Exhaaaale... This is terrible. The balance I finally achieved between mind, magic, and body is about to collapse!!
Affinity_Asana_EP03_004: What happened? I will at least listen.
Affinity_Asana_EP03_005: Sigh... You see, Lady Fricle rejected my paper... again... Grrr...!
Affinity_Asana_EP03_006: Would you like a glass of cold water?
Affinity_Asana_EP03_007: Thank you. Whew... A cold glass of water has helped me calm down. Whew... Even after practicing yoga for so long, true inner peace remains incredibly difficult!
Affinity_Asana_EP04_001: Master, do you not think the food here is rather sweet and salty?
Affinity_Asana_EP04_002: You are the one accustomed to bland food.
Affinity_Asana_EP04_003: Master, would you listen to me? When you appreciate the ingredients' natural flavors, your palate and mind both grow healthier. Then you can achieve true unity of mind, magic, and body... Where are you looking?
Affinity_Asana_EP04_004: Shall I season your food more lightly?
Affinity_Asana_EP04_005: Yes, please. I have been following a yoga diet while concentrating on my training, so heavily seasoned food upsets my stomach a little.
Affinity_Asana_EP04_006: If I do not, people will file complaints.
Affinity_Asana_EP04_007: Oh... Master... You must suffer terribly from all those complaints. At times like that, yoga and meditation are surely... What? You want me to finish my meal first?
Affinity_Asana_EP05_001: I never imagined I would return to graduate school~
Affinity_Asana_EP05_003: Whew... I never expected to return either... I suppose I truly am impressive. You agree, do you not, Master? Hehe.
Affinity_Asana_EP05_004: You can quit if it becomes too difficult!
Affinity_Asana_EP05_005: How can you give up so easily~?! Once you begin a study, you must see it through to the end.
Affinity_Asana_EP05_006: Welcome back. This is your second time in graduate school, right?
Affinity_Asana_EP05_007: Um... Master, pardon me, but you do not believe I possess only one advanced Witch degree... do you?
Affinity_Asana_EP06_001: Exercise is not simply about building muscle, you know?!
Affinity_Asana_EP06_003: Flexibility! And unity of mind, magic, and body! That is what matters. Only through that unity can you maximize the benefits of exercise.
Affinity_Asana_EP06_004: Is exercise not for building muscle?
Affinity_Asana_EP06_005: Sigh... Honestly... Master, would you sit here? You see, exercise is...
Affinity_Asana_EP06_006: You are right. Flexibility matters too.
Affinity_Asana_EP06_007: You speak the truth, Master. Everyone ought to understand the importance of flexibility... What good is mindlessly building nothing but muscle?
Affinity_Asana_EP07_001: I am thinking of opening a yoga studio in Monatium. What do you think?
Affinity_Asana_EP07_003: It is still a little early for the Witch Kingdom. The Elves in Monatium are easily swayed, so they are much easier to entice... Oh, please keep that secret.
Affinity_Asana_EP07_004: That sounds like a good idea.
Affinity_Asana_EP07_005: Right? Everyone wants an excuse to slack... Oh, that is not what I meant. Everyone seems to need rest. Haha. It would be wonderful if we could practice yoga and train together!
Affinity_Asana_EP07_007: Huh... W-Why? Um... If someone needs rest, they can simply be hospitalized...? Why would they be hospitalized when they are not ill?!
Affinity_Asana_EP08_001: I devised a new pose. What do you think?
Affinity_Asana_EP08_003: Hehe, correct. It is a meditative pose. Lie flat like this with your palms facing upward, and feel the magic gathering at your navel... Zzz... Zzz...
Affinity_Asana_EP08_004: It looks ideal for falling asleep.
Affinity_Asana_EP08_005: What are you saying?! You are supposed to meditate, not sleep! Master, you have not been secretly sleeping during meditation all this time, have you?
Affinity_Asana_EP08_006: I feel as though I have seen that pose somewhere.
Affinity_Asana_EP08_007: It is probably not your imagination. I created it using yoga materials I received from Ms. Hilde. Hehe!
Affinity_Asana_EP09_001: Talking with Ms. Hilde is enjoyable and enlightening!
Affinity_Asana_EP09_002: You have made a good friend.
Affinity_Asana_EP09_003: Yes. We understand each other remarkably well. She is also extremely knowledgeable about meditation and healing.
Affinity_Asana_EP09_005: Yes. Recently, I have been receiving some advice from Ms. Hilde about healing and meditation. Her knowledge of mental and physical well-being is remarkable!
Affinity_Asana_EP09_006: Has something been troubling you lately?
Affinity_Asana_EP09_007: Ugh... Ughh... My paper... rejected for the 387th time already... Ugh... U-Ughhhhh...!
Affinity_Asana_EP10_001: Ugh... Ughhh! My paper failed review again! Ughhh! Why can nobody understand it?!
Affinity_Asana_EP10_002: Was it like this with your old magic papers too?
Affinity_Asana_EP10_003: No! Back then, my papers passed as soon as I submitted them! It is so unfair. Why can nobody comprehend the greatness of my theory of mind, magic, and body?
Affinity_Asana_EP10_005: Everyone should recognize yoga's benefits as you do, Master. Still, that only awakens my competitive spirit. I will make everyone understand how wonderful it is!
Affinity_Asana_EP10_006: How did you write the paper for it to keep failing?
Affinity_Asana_EP10_007: Ugh... Nngh... Grrr... Even you would say that, Master... Grrr...! I wrote it perfectly well...! I truly did!
Affinity_Asana_EP11_001: There is an excellent stretching pose: cross your legs while standing, then bend forward...
Affinity_Asana_EP11_002: Your cheeks must be heavy. You can still manage that pose?
Affinity_Asana_EP11_003: The key is your center of gravity and core strength! I am sure you can do it even better, Master!
Affinity_Asana_EP11_004: Hup. Is this how I do it?
Affinity_Asana_EP11_005: Wow. Your legs are so long, Master, that you may be able to cross them twice! Amazing!
Affinity_Asana_EP11_006: Crossing my legs while seated is quite enough.
Affinity_Asana_EP11_007: You will strain your lower back that way! Maintain proper posture!
Affinity_Asana_EP12_001: Master, would you take a deep breath out? Blow like this: hoo, hoo. Yes, ten times!
Affinity_Asana_EP12_002: You are asking me to cool something hot, are you not?
Affinity_Asana_EP12_003: Ahaha. You caught me! Would you blow ten more times? It is still too hot.
Affinity_Asana_EP12_004: Breathe in~ Breathe out~ Breathe in~
Affinity_Asana_EP12_005: Hey! Why are you talking during the breathing exercise? I told you only to breathe!
Affinity_Asana_EP12_006: Is it obvious that I am stressed?
Affinity_Asana_EP12_007: You look extremely tense. Now, breathe slowly once more!
Affinity_Asana_EP13_001: Do I look cold? To one who has mastered the essence of yoga, this weather is practically warm.
Affinity_Asana_EP13_002: I wish you would put on another layer. You will upset your stomach.
Affinity_Asana_EP13_003: That is very considerate... but I must express what kind of Witch I am through my clothing, or nobody will believe me.
Affinity_Asana_EP13_004: If you feel warm, then I suppose it is fine.
Affinity_Asana_EP13_005: Thank you for respecting my choice. I would actually like to wear something even more flowing, but it is difficult to keep everything in place.
Affinity_Asana_EP13_006: Is that what mastering the essence of yoga means?
Affinity_Asana_EP13_007: They say a strong body puts the mind at ease, do they not? My mind is already quite capable, of course.
Affinity_Asana_EP14_001: No matter how flexible I become, it seems I still cannot avoid the occasional leg cramp.
Affinity_Asana_EP14_002: They say putting saliva on your nose cures it!
Affinity_Asana_EP14_003: W-Wait! Move your finger away! I would rather use my own saliva!
Affinity_Asana_EP14_004: Give me your leg. I will massage it.
Affinity_Asana_EP14_005: I-It is a little difficult to stretch my leg across the table. Is putting my foot on the dining table truly acceptable?
Affinity_Asana_EP14_006: Let us build more grit so cramps cannot defeat you.
Affinity_Asana_EP14_007: That is exactly the attitude! I will overcome cramps through unity of mind, magic, and body!
Affinity_Asana_EP15_001: What do you believe matters most when helping someone in pain feel at ease?
Affinity_Asana_EP15_002: Would they not feel at ease if they lost consciousness?
Affinity_Asana_EP15_003: Master, would you like to feel at ease for a moment? I can arrange that very quickly.
Affinity_Asana_EP15_005: Those matter too, but should we not first create an environment in which they can relax?
Affinity_Asana_EP15_006: First, send everyone else out and place them somewhere quiet.
Affinity_Asana_EP15_007: That sounds ideal. Is an environment with only the patient and healer not best?
Affinity_Asana_EP16_001: Ball yoga is excellent exercise, but it may be a little difficult for you, Master.
Affinity_Asana_EP16_002: Instead, I have a technique for loosening all of your cheeks.
Affinity_Asana_EP16_003: That is true. You have five fingers, so there are areas where you hold an advantage over us!
Affinity_Asana_EP16_004: Hmm. That is certainly a form unique to the bodies of Elias.
Affinity_Asana_EP16_005: Do you realize it is rude to stare at my cheeks while saying that?
Affinity_Asana_EP16_006: There are muscles in the cheeks too?
Affinity_Asana_EP16_007: Muscles exist throughout the body. Somewhere, there may even be an Apostle who specifically trains their cheek muscles.
Affinity_Asana_EP17_001: Ta-da~ Master, would you like some detox juice? You could even serve it as dessert in the banquet hall!
Affinity_Asana_EP17_003: Detoxification begins by emptying the stomach, so I filled it with a few stimulating ingredients! Would you like some?
Affinity_Asana_EP17_005: If it empties your stomach completely, would all the toxins not leave with everything else? Huh? Why are you looking at me like that?
Affinity_Asana_EP17_006: Do not open the lid. I can already smell how spicy it is.
Affinity_Asana_EP17_007: Does merely smelling it not make you feel the toxins disappearing? Come now, you need to try it first~
Affinity_Asana_EP18_001: Even when I devise excellent exercises, they are useless if nobody wishes to learn them. That is the difficult part.
Affinity_Asana_EP18_002: A sufficient threat can create a willingness to learn.
Affinity_Asana_EP18_003: That is not a bad idea. Sometimes coercive measures are necessary.
Affinity_Asana_EP18_004: What if you offer them a benefit each time they learn something?
Affinity_Asana_EP18_005: That sounds promising. Hmm, reward them every time they succeed... What a fresh perspective.
Affinity_Asana_EP18_006: Leave them alone. If they refuse to learn, it is their loss.
Affinity_Asana_EP18_007: Come now. That is still much better than having them return later, sobbing and begging me to fix them.
Affinity_Asana_EP19_001: If you spread yoga throughout the World Tree Order, Master, would all the Apostles not become healthier?
Affinity_Asana_EP19_002: Do you have yoga equipment that fits my body?
Affinity_Asana_EP19_003: Huh? You are right. You cannot use our equipment... Would I have to build something new? This is becoming an enormous undertaking.
Affinity_Asana_EP19_004: Everyone wriggling together in one place would look rather adorable.
Affinity_Asana_EP19_005: The purpose is training, not cuteness. Still, if it is cute too, that is twice the benefit!
Affinity_Asana_EP19_007: Hmm~ The High Priest wields considerable influence over the surface Order, does she not? Understood.
Affinity_Asana_EP20_002: Climb onto my back and step on it. That will straighten it.
Affinity_Asana_EP20_003: Should I climb on? I can step on it now, correct?
Affinity_Asana_EP20_004: What if I walk around leaning the opposite way? Would that straighten it?
Affinity_Asana_EP20_005: Of course it would not! Sometimes you say truly strange things, Master.
Affinity_Asana_EP20_006: Human spines naturally look like this.
Affinity_Asana_EP20_007: Huh? They do? Come to think of it, I believe the medical books in Monatium also showed curved spines. How fascinating!
